title: ViewerProtocol
description: Both directions, for the JSON Schema that generates the TypeScript types.

AgentRow.description: One row of `agents.parquet`, as it would be if the run ended now.

x_world.description: World position relative to `origin`, and heading (rad).

in.description: The ribbon that arrives here; its end is the stop line.

out.description: The ribbon that leaves from here.

AttractorSpec.description:
A stretch of a ribbon along which the stop-anywhere rate of every class
(`road.stop_anywhere.rate.*`) is multiplied. It changes an incentive and
nothing else (ADR-0005).

stop_rate_multiplier.description:
Factor on the rate of stops per vehicle-kilometre (not on flow or
capacity).

BarrierSpec.description:
A stop line across the whole carriageway. While it is closed, vehicles
that have not crossed it stop before it (ADR-0010; Kanagaraj & Treiber
model a red light as a standing virtual vehicle across the road).

closed.description: Periods during which the barrier is closed.

s.description: Station of the stop line on the ribbon.

oneOf.description: The first event of this kind (`events.parquet` `kind`, e.g. `collision_guard`).
Simulated time reaches `t` (s).

BusStopSpec.description:
A kerbside bus stop at the left edge. Buses that serve it pull in, stand
for a dwell time and drive on (ADR-0014's stop mechanism); where they
stand is drawn from the register's offsets (`road.bus.*`).

length.description: Length of the platform along the road (m).

s.description: Station of the middle of the platform (m).

serving_share.description: Share of passing buses that stop here, 0–1.

stop_rate_multiplier.description:
Factor on the stop-anywhere rate along the platform (autos and
e-rickshaws gather at stops); omit for none.

waiting_passenger_width.description:
Width of carriageway taken by passengers waiting on the road along
the platform (m); omit for the register's
`road.bus.waiting_passenger_width`, 0 for none.

ClassHist.description: Speeds of the agents in the network now, by class.

oneOf.description: Advance `n` steps, then pause.
Time warp: simulated seconds per wall second (0 = as fast as possible).

Change a `live: true` register entry, in its register unit. With
`resample`, also re-draw it for agents already in the network.
Re-draw a per-agent parameter for every agent in the network.
Revert the latest parameter change not yet undone.
Inspect an agent (`null` to stop).
Signals arrive in P8; refused until then.

Put a road object on the road from the next step on (ribbon
coordinates, as in a scenario's `network.objects`).
Take a road object off the road from the next step on.
Write the session folder and verify it by a headless replay.
Viewer settings ([`ViewSettings`]): not logged, no effect on the run.

ClosedInterval.description:
A period `from_s <= t < to_s` (simulated seconds): a barrier is closed,
or an object is on the road.

ColourBy.description: What the per-agent `colour` value of a frame holds.

oneOf.description: Vehicle class index (`VehicleClass::ALL`).
Speed (m/s).
Speed over desired speed.
Acceleration (m/s²).
Lateral position in the ribbon frame (m, + left of travel).
Desired speed v0 (m/s).
Persona (P8).
Aggressiveness κ (P8).
Violation state (P8).
Zone (P9).

categorical.description: `true` if the value is categorical (an index into `classes`).

ControlSpec.description: Who goes first at a junction.

oneOf.description:
No signal. Movements from `major` arms have priority over the
others; lower-priority movements wait for a gap (G§2.4). With no
major arm every movement has the same priority and nobody waits for
a gap: vehicles sort it out inside the junction.
A fixed-time signal (G§6.6, normal state).

countdown.description:
The countdown display. It changes nothing while every driver
complies (P7); violations read it from P8 on.

offset_s.description: Time into the cycle at simulated time 0 (s).

phases.description: Stages in order; the cycle is the sum of their times.

DetectorRow.description: One row of `detectors.parquet` (see the data dictionary); `null` = not measured.

oneOf.description: Counts vehicles crossing station `s`.

Measures density, flow and space-mean speed over `[s_from, s_to]`
(Edie's generalised definitions).

Dist.description:
A univariate distribution.

Several lognormal forms are accepted for readability in the register; they
are converted to `(mu, sigma)` of `ln X` by [`Dist::canonical`].

oneOf.description: Always the same value.
Normal with mean and standard deviation.
Normal restricted to `[min, max]` (rejection sampling).
Lognormal by the mean and SD of `ln X`.
Lognormal by its median and the SD of `ln X`.
Lognormal by the mean and SD of `X` itself.
Lognormal through two quantiles: `P(X ≤ x_lo) = p_lo`, `P(X ≤ x_hi) = p_hi`.
Gamma with shape `k` and scale `θ` (mean `kθ`).
Exponential with the given mean.
`shift + Exponential`, parameterised by the shift and the overall mean.
Uniform on `[min, max]`.
Piecewise-linear inverse CDF through `[p, x]` points, `p` rising from 0 to 1.
Finite mixture; weights need not sum to 1 (they are normalised).

EffectiveWidthSpec.description:
An effective-width observer over `[s_from, s_to]` of a ribbon, in bins
of `bin_m` along the road. Per bin it reports the width road objects
leave free, the shy distance the clearance model predicts for the
vehicles that passed, and the width those vehicles actually used
(`effective_width.parquet`). It reports; it changes nothing.

bin_m.description: Length of a bin along the road (m).

EntrySpec.description: One entry: a flow profile and a vehicle composition (G§7.1–7.3).

composition.description:
Share of each vehicle type in the stream (normalised; count it at the
site — registration shares are not the stream, G§7.1).

flow.description: Piecewise-constant flow: each interval applies from `from_s` until the next.

s.description: Station of the entry on the ribbon.

upstream_signal.description:
Feed the entry from a signal upstream instead of letting arrivals
in as they come (G§7.3).

bounds.description: Network bounds `[x0, y0, x1, y1]`, relative to `origin`.

initial_run_hash.description: Run hash of the scenario and seed before any command.

live_window_s.description: Interval of the live detector windows in `Kpi.windows` (s).

origin.description: World coordinates of the frame origin: every position sent is relative to it.

HumpSpec.description: A speed hump across the road, or part of it.

s.description: Station of its middle and its extent along the road (m).

y_from.description:
Lateral extent; omit either for the carriageway edge. A hump that
stops short of an edge leaves a gap narrow vehicles can use.

found.description: `false` if the agent is not in the network (not entered yet, or exited).

note.description: Persona, traits and decision explanations arrive with P8.

JunctionSpec.description:
A junction: arms (a ribbon arriving, a ribbon leaving, or both), the
share of each arriving stream that leaves by each arm, and who goes
first. The builder makes the ribbons inside it.

- `box`: one wide, lane-free movement ribbon from each arriving arm to
  each arm its traffic leaves by, and the areas where two of them overlap.
  A median opening is a box with two opposite carriageways as arms and
  U-turn shares.
- `split`: the arriving ribbon hands over directly to the leaving
  ribbons, which must start where it ends and share its frame (each
  takes part of its width). A vehicle must be inside its branch's part of
  the width when it gets there (G§6.7).
- `roundabout`: a ring of arc ribbons round `centre`, with a connector
  from each arriving arm onto the ring and one off it to each leaving
  arm (ADR-0009). Traffic circulates clockwise (left-hand traffic).

centre.description:
Roundabout: centre of the island (world metres), radius of the
middle of the circulating carriageway and its width (m).

sign_visibility_distance.description:
Split: how far before the split its sign can be read (m); omit for
the register's `split.sign_visibility_distance`.

turns.description:
Turning shares: arriving arm → leaving arm → share (normalised per
arriving arm; count them at the site, G§7.5). A pair that is absent
or zero gets no movement.

u_turn_path.description:
U-turns (a movement back out by the arm it came in by, or whose
leaving ribbon runs against the arriving one): how far from the
median edge of the receiving carriageway a U-turning vehicle joins
it (m). Omit for the register's `gap_acceptance.u_turn.path.*`.

Kpi.description: Sent once per wall second (and after steps while paused).

kpis.description: Headline KPIs if the run ended now (the computation of `kpis.parquet`).

windows.description: Live detector windows that closed since the last message.

throughput_detector.description: Screenline whose count is the throughput KPI.

Neighbour.description: One agent the inspected agent's leader scan considers (plan/03 §2).

leader_accel.description: IDM acceleration toward this leader alone (null for side neighbours).

weight.description: Leader weight ω (null for side neighbours).

NetworkSpec.description: Road geometry as a set of ribbons (ADR-0002).

attractors.description:
Places where vehicles stop to pick up and set down more often (a
metro exit, a market): G§6.2, ADR-0014.

barriers.description:
Stop lines that are closed during given periods (a level crossing, a
police barrier). Signals arrive in phase P7.

junctions.description:
Junctions: places where ribbons meet and vehicles choose where to
go (G§2.4, §6.6, §6.7; ADR-0009, ADR-0016).

objects.description:
Road objects: things with a position and a footprint that vehicles
react to (G§6, plan/03-model-design.md §10). They act only through
usable width, speed caps, gap supply and incentives; there is no
capacity or flow factor to set (ADR-0005).

parking.description:
Stretches of kerb where vehicles park (G§6.2). Each parked vehicle
is a road object; parking and unparking block space for a while.

surfaces.description:
Stretches with a gradient or a rough surface (G§6.9, G§6.1): they
lower desired speeds by class and do nothing else.

oneOf.description: A solid body on the carriageway.
A vehicle parked at the kerb, or standing beside one (double parked).
A vehicle manoeuvring into or out of a parking space.
Passengers waiting on the carriageway at a bus stop.
A pedestrian, or a group, crossing the road.
A pothole: not a body; vehicles swerve, slow, straddle or hit it.
A speed hump: not a body; a speed cap by vehicle.
Standing water shallow enough to drive through: a speed cap.

ObjectResponse.description: How one vehicle class responds to a road object.

oneOf.description: The footprint is not usable: the class goes around it or stops.
The class takes no notice of the object.

ObjectSpec.description:
A road object: a rectangle lying along a ribbon (a parked vehicle, a
vendor's cart, debris). Vehicles see it as a standing body: they keep
their lateral clearance to it, brake for it and steer around it like
they do for a stopped vehicle.

clearance_as.description:
The vehicle class whose lateral-clearance line and following
multipliers apply to this object (a parked car is passed like a
car). Omit for the pooled clearance line.

length.description: Extent of the footprint along the ribbon (m).

present.description: Periods during which the object is on the road; empty means always.

response.description: How each vehicle class responds; classes not listed are blocked.

s.description: Station of the footprint's centre on the ribbon (m).

width.description: Extent of the footprint across the ribbon (m).

y.description: Lateral position of the footprint's centre (m).

ObjectView.description: A road object and when it is on the road.

present.description: Periods `[from, to)` on the road; `null` = no bound on that side.

shape.description: Corners of the footprint, relative to `Hello.origin`.

effective_width.description:
Effective-width observers: how much of the carriageway traffic
uses, against what road objects leave free (G§6.2).

trajectories.description: Trajectory sampling; omit to write no trajectories.

ParamValue.description: A parameter value: a plain number or a distribution.

ParkingSpec.description:
Kerbside parking along one side of a ribbon (G§6.2). Parked vehicles are
drawn at the start of the run to fill `occupancy` of the kerb length;
they are road objects, so they act only by taking width (ADR-0005).

The survey quantities (`offset_from_kerb`, `double_parking_probability`,
`manoeuvres_per_100m_h`, `cruising_share`) may be given here for this
stretch; where omitted, the register value is used
(`road.parking.*`), and the run is refused if that is unset too.

composition.description: Vehicle types that park here, with weights.

cruising_share.description:
Share of passing vehicles (of the types that park here) that are
looking for a space and slow down along this stretch.

double_parking_probability.description: Probability that a parked vehicle has another standing beside it.

manoeuvres_per_100m_h.description: Parking and unparking manoeuvres per 100 m of kerb per hour.

occupancy.description:
Share of the kerb length taken by parked vehicles at the start, 0–1
(measure it from video or imagery).

offset_from_kerb.description: Gap between the kerb and a parked vehicle (m).

s_from.description: The stretch of kerb, by station (m).

side.description: Which edge of the carriageway the vehicles park at.

PedestrianCrossingSpec.description: A stretch along which pedestrians cross wherever they are (G§6.4).

from_left_share.description:
Share that starts from the left edge (the kerb); the rest start from
the right edge (the median).

per_hour.description: Crossings (groups) per hour over the whole stretch.

PhaseSpec.description:
One stage of a fixed-time plan: green for every movement from `arms`
(and for the listed `movements`, written `from>to`), then amber, then
red for all.

PotholeFieldSpec.description: A stretch with potholes, placed at random at the start of the run.

kerb_bias.description:
How much more often they lie towards the kerb (left): 0 is uniform
across the road, 1 is none at the median edge rising linearly to
twice the mean at the kerb.

per_km.description: Potholes per kilometre of road; omit for `road.pothole.density`.

RibbonSpec.description:
A ribbon: a reference polyline with a lateral width profile. `y` is
positive to the left of the direction of travel; for left-hand traffic the
kerb is on the left (`y_max`) and the median on the right (`y_min`).

next.description: The ribbon traffic continues onto at the end, if any.

polyline.description: Reference line vertices in world metres (UTM or local), at least two.

width.description:
Width profile: lateral bounds at stations along the ribbon
(piecewise linear between stations, constant beyond the ends).

outline.description: Carriageway polygon (right edge forward, left edge back), relative to `origin`.

RoadSide.description: An edge of the carriageway, seen in the direction of travel.

oneOf.description: `y_max`: the kerb in left-hand traffic.
`y_min`: the median side in left-hand traffic.

Scenario.description: A scenario: what to simulate, for how long, and what to record.

duration_s.description: Simulated duration including warm-up, in seconds.

kpi.description: Which detectors the headline KPIs use.

name.description: Short identifier, used in run folder names.

overrides.description: Parameter overrides by register path, in the register entry's unit.

warmup_s.description: Initial period excluded from KPIs and detector summaries, in seconds.

oneOf.description: Outcome of a command; `seq` is its position in the command log.
The session paused at a breakpoint.
The session folder was written and replayed headless.

Every road object, sent on connecting and whenever one is added or
removed.

real_time_factor.description: Measured simulated seconds per wall second over the last second.

run_hash.description: Run identity including the commands so far.

speed.description: Simulated seconds per wall second (0 = as fast as possible).

SurfaceSpec.description: A stretch with an upgrade and/or a rough surface.

gradient_percent.description: Upgrade in percent (0 or omitted: level).

roughness_iri.description: Roughness in IRI units above a smooth surface (omitted: smooth).

every_s.description: Sampling interval in seconds (a multiple of `dt_s`).

from_t.description: Only record from this time on (default: end of warm-up).

s_from.description: Only record agents with `s` in `[s_from, s_to]` (any ribbon).

TsSamples.description: Time–space samples of one ribbon (positions rounded to 1 cm, speeds to 0.01 m/s).

UpstreamSignalSpec.description:
A signal upstream of an entry, not otherwise simulated: arrivals wait
in the entry's queue while it is red and are let in while it is green,
so they enter in platoons (G§7.3).

offset_s.description: Time into the cycle at simulated time 0 (s); green comes first.

VehicleClass.description: Vehicle class: the level at which most interaction parameters are given.

WaterSpec.description:
A patch of standing water. It caps speed on it (from its depth: G§6.10
cites the depth–speed curve of Pregnolato et al. 2017), or closes the
patch altogether, and hides the potholes under it.

closed.description: Too deep to drive through: the patch takes its width.

speed_cap_kmh.description: Speed vehicles can keep through it (km/h); omit if `closed`.

y_from.description: Lateral extent; omit either for the carriageway edge.

WidthPoint.description: Lateral bounds of the carriageway at station `s`.
